_note: Per-product English for everything that comes out of the Korean deck: spec values, the one-liner, and the [features & benefits] block. Brief text lives in briefs.json, the longer write-ups in etc.json.
_rules: Write for a creator on camera, not for a regulator. Short sentences.
Never invent a claim the deck does not make.
Keep every hedge the Korean carries: immediate, temporary, individual variation.
No prices, no launch dates, no manufacturer, no certificate numbers.
